tasks: Fix GitHub issues #972 and #974 together: two hardware-reserve correctness bugs in the state machine and controller. (#972) The health check's expected hardware state for SPIKE_DISCHARGE is a hardcoded backup reserve of 10 (custom_components/localshift/state/machine.py _get_expected_state_for_mode), but _build_spike_discharge_config writes spike_reserve_soc when switch.localshift_spike_discharge_conservative is on (live today, typically 20-60) or minimum_target_soc otherwise. Unlike PROACTIVE_EXPORT and GRID_CHARGING there is no tracked reserve to override the expectation, and state/validator.py's tolerance is abs(actual - expected) < 1, so during a conservative spike discharge the health check mismatches every tick and re-issues the transition every 5 minutes with a Health Check Correction notification each time. Add spike_discharge_reserve to ModeConfig and _update_transition_reserves and use it in _perform_health_check exactly the way _proactive_export_reserve is used. Also: _build_spike_discharge_config and _build_hold_config read self._get_option('minimum_target_soc', 10.0) while BatteryController._get_minimum_target_soc uses DEFAULT_MINIMUM_TARGET_SOC (20); use CONF_MINIMUM_TARGET_SOC and DEFAULT_MINIMUM_TARGET_SOC in both builders. Test: command SPIKE_DISCHARGE with conservative reserve 45, hardware reports 45, assert verify_current_state is called with expected reserve 45 and no correction fires. (#974) The actuator-side reserve for PROACTIVE_EXPORT is max(4, soc - 5) in both _build_proactive_export_config (state/machine.py) and BatteryController.set_proactive_export (integration/controller.py), and only honours minimum_target_soc in the current_soc <= 0.0 branch (#895 half-fix); for SOC between minimum_target_soc and minimum_target_soc + 5 the hardware is told to discharge below the configured floor the planner never models. Replace with reserve = max(minimum_target_soc, soc - PROACTIVE_EXPORT_SOC_BUFFER_PERCENT) in ONE shared helper called from both places so they cannot drift again; the 4 percent absolute floor becomes redundant. Test: minimum_target_soc 20, SOC 22 -> reserve 20 in both the builder and the controller. Write failing tests first; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issues #971, #977 and #978 together: stale entity references left behind by removed or renamed entities. (#971) custom_components/localshift/services/notification_service.py reads sensor.grid_import_energy_daily, sensor.grid_export_energy_daily and sensor.solar_production_energy_daily for the end-of-day summary; all three were removed with the legacy YAML stack (#880) and return ENTITY_NOT_FOUND, so the summary always reports 0.0 kWh. Use the integration's own daily accumulators data.grid_import_kwh_today and data.grid_export_kwh_today (#868). For solar, add solar_kwh_today to CostTracker._accumulate_energy_kwh in custom_components/localshift/utils/costs.py using the same one-line pattern as the grid accumulators, and reset it on the midnight reset path (note PR #988 just made tick_scheduler.handle_midnight_reset delegate to CostTracker.reset_daily_accumulators, so add it there). Remove NotificationService._read_float if nothing else uses it afterwards. (#977) scripts/snapshot_charging_plan.py references eleven entities that no longer exist: sensor.localshift_forecast_daily and sensor.localshift_forecast_grid (renamed in #447 to sensor.localshift_optimizer_plan and sensor.localshift_optimizer_plan_grid), the thermal entities (binary_sensor.localshift_thermal_management_enabled, sensor.localshift_daily_thermal_mode, number.localshift_cooling_trigger_temp, number.localshift_heating_trigger_temp), the learning entities (sensor.localshift_decision_quality, sensor.localshift_learning_status, switch.localshift_enable_learning, retired in #962), and binary_sensor.localshift_preconditioning_active / binary_sensor.localshift_solar_taper_active. Repoint the plan and grid reads to the #447 names, delete the thermal and learning sections, and add a guard that warns when a requested entity is absent instead of printing unknown. (#978) Update the user-facing docs where they reference removed or renamed entities: in docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md, docs/OPTIMIZER_DP_ROLLOUT.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, docs/LOAD_SHIFTING_GUIDE.md, docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md, docs/LEARNING_SYSTEM.md and README.md fix: forecast_daily/forecast_grid -> optimizer_plan/optimizer_plan_grid; optimizer_comparison (deleted), optimizer_shadow_plan/optimizer_shadow_summary -> optimizer_plan_detailed/optimizer_summary; sensor.localshift_excess_solar -> sensor.localshift_excess_solar_kwh; remove sensor.localshift_extended_forecast_accuracy (does not exist); switch.localshift_notify_alerts/notify_daily_summary/notify_manual_actions/notify_transitions -> switch.localshift_notifications_enabled (#214); remove sensor.localshift_decision_quality from LEARNING_SYSTEM.md (#962); number.localshift_target_shortfall_penalty -> number.localshift_target_penalty. Add a test under tests/ that extracts every domain.localshift_* id referenced under scripts/, docs/ and README.md and asserts each one is registered by the integration (sensor _attr_unique_id values, NUMBER_DEFINITIONS, SWITCH_*, SELECT_*, BUTTON_*), so a future rename fails CI. Write failing tests first; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #973: sensor attributes that are permanently at their default because nothing writes the field they read (same class as #917, one level down). Verified live 2026-09-05. In custom_components/localshift/sensors/forecast.py: delete the five forecast_import_cost / forecast_export_revenue / forecast_net_cost / forecast_grid_charge_cost / forecast_proactive_export_revenue attributes and their CoordinatorData fields in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/data.py (the DP summary already carries projected_net_cost and projected_import_kwh); delete consumption_statistic_id, consumption_fallback_hours and adaptive_params_values from the forecast_diagnostics attributes and data.py (no writer; adaptive_params is inert since #962). In custom_components/localshift/sensors/optimizer.py: delete projected_solar_gain_pct, adjusted_solar_gain_pct and effective_soc_at_terminal, which _build_summary stopped emitting in #816. In custom_components/localshift/engine/core.py: _solve only calls _get_terminal_diagnostics when not solar_capable, so dw_entry_soc_pct and peak_soc_pct on sensor.localshift_optimizer_summary are None on every solar-capable day, which is exactly when the runway backstop relies on them; compute the terminal diagnostics unconditionally (it is cheap), and fix the `round(dw_entry_soc, 2) if dw_entry_soc else None` expression so a legitimate 0.0 is published as 0.0 rather than None. Remove the matching lines from docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md (the forecast_*_cost rows around line 253-255, consumption_statistic_id around 304, and the #816 leftovers around 796-799). Add a static test under tests/ that walks every `data.<field>` read in custom_components/localshift/sensors/ via the AST and asserts each field has at least one production writer outside coordinator/data.py, so this class cannot recur silently. Write failing tests first; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #975: every write to a LocalShift number, switch or select entity runs the full recompute-and-evaluate cycle twice, each time invalidating the decision fingerprint. custom_components/localshift/number.py async_set_native_value calls hass.config_entries.async_update_entry(options=...) and then coordinator.async_recompute_and_evaluate(); custom_components/localshift/__init__.py registers _async_options_updated as the entry update listener, which calls coordinator.async_recompute_and_evaluate() again on every entry update plus reschedule_daily_summary_timer() and reset_entity_tracking_on_options_change(). switch.py and select.py follow the same pattern. Pick one owner: make the update listener the single trigger and drop the explicit async_recompute_and_evaluate() calls from the number, switch and select platforms, keeping the listener's timer and entity-tracking upkeep so options-flow saves (which do not go through the platforms) still work. Be careful with select.py: it falls through to async_set_battery_mode rather than a recompute, and #934 (options reload re-asserting the select) is being fixed on a sibling branch, so keep the select change minimal and do not alter the manual-override semantics. Add a unit test that counts compute_derived_values invocations per async_set_native_value and pins it at exactly one, and the same for a switch toggle. Write failing tests first; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #976: leftover per-cycle INFO diagnostic logging, several lines per optimizer cycle, most tagged with closed issues. Delete outright the ISSUE_500 lines in custom_components/localshift/engine/slots.py (the per-30-min-slot 'ISSUE_500 slot_builder:' line between 11:00-14:00) and custom_components/localshift/forecast/pipeline.py ('ISSUE_500 load_forecast_slots:'), since #500 closed 2026-03-04 and the SLOT0_CURRENT line carries the same information. Demote to DEBUG: 'SLOT0_CURRENT:', 'HYBRID_SLOTS: slots=...', 'HYBRID_SLOTS: First 5 slots', 'Slot 0 TZ info', 'Slot 1 TZ info' in custom_components/localshift/engine/slot_schedule.py; 'Excess solar:' in custom_components/localshift/engine/excess_solar_signals.py; 'Health check verify:' in custom_components/localshift/state/validator.py (the 'DIAGNOSTIC: Always log at INFO' one, every minute in stable mode); 'State machine evaluate:' in custom_components/localshift/state/machine.py (every minute); and the forecast-parsing chatter in custom_components/localshift/learning/temperature.py. Keep 'Hybrid slot schedule:' in slot_schedule.py at INFO only when the horizon (slot count or first/last slot start) changed since the previous cycle, otherwise DEBUG. Do not touch the pre-charge decision, backstop, boundary-lag or transition INFO lines. Add a test under tests/ that scans custom_components/localshift for _LOGGER.info( or _LOGGER.warning( calls whose format string contains ISSUE_<digits> and fails if any exist, so the pattern cannot recur. Update any existing tests that assert on the demoted messages at INFO. Keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #985: DPPlanner.__init__(config) in custom_components/localshift/engine/core.py stores the argument in self._config and never reads it; plan() takes its configuration from inputs.config, so the constructor argument is silently ignored. Production constructs DPPlanner() with no argument; 34 test call sites (tests/test_optimizer_dp_solve.py, tests/test_optimizer_self_consumption.py and others) pass a config the solver ignores, so any test doing DPPlanner(config_a).plan(inputs_with_config_b) is exercising config_b. Remove the constructor parameter entirely so a positional argument fails loudly, then fix every call site: for each one, check whether the config passed to the constructor matches the config on the inputs it plans, and where they differ, make the inputs carry the config the test's name and assertions clearly intend, reporting in your summary each site whose premise turned out to be wrong. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.
